description:
Run enrichment over leads this account ALREADY OWNS, from a selection created by create_bulk_selection. THIS IS THE CALL THAT SPENDS.

⚠️ FREE AT THE SOURCE IS NOT FREE. Nothing is paid to read our own corpus, so every cost field on the response reads zero or null. The run still spends real enrichment: eligible_leads x the stages you enabled. Do NOT tell a user this run is free because the money fields are empty — branch on what is being enriched, not on what was bought.

⚠️ vayapin publishes a PERMANENT PUBLIC profile page per lead. It is off unless you set it. Turning it on for a 4,000-lead selection mints 4,000 public pages that do not come back.

The filter is NOT accepted here and there is no field for it — only the selection_id. An id naming no selection this account owns is a 404 (never a 403, which would confirm the id exists).

The provider is not called during this request: the API writes a manifest, returns 202 with a job_id, and the bulk worker drives the rest. There is no bulk-specific status route — poll get_job_status with the returned job_id, and read results with get_job_results.

priority.description: Queue priority for the fanned-out leads (0-10).

selection_id.description: The id returned by create_bulk_selection. The only thing this route accepts about WHICH leads to run.

source_kind.description: The selection's own kind: 'corpus_query' or 'unenriched_run'. Must match what create_bulk_selection was given.

workflow.description: Which downstream stages each lead runs through. Same shape as a campaign. Set only the stages you sized the selection against — enabling one you did not count changes the bill.

vayapin.description: { enabled: boolean } — publish a PERMANENT public profile per lead. Off unless explicitly set.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: submit_bulk_internal_sourcing
